bio:
Elizabeth (Grub) Michael (1761 - after 1826), m. Peter Michael.

FamilySearch gives Maria Elizabeth's baptism as 5 Jul 1761 at the Tohickon Reformed Church, Bucks Co. (born 5 Jun), citing Historical Society of Pennsylvania baptism cards. That is the same congregation where Casper Doll's daughter was baptized in 1757. It gives her marriage to Peter Michael in 1783, with children in Forks Twp from 1784 ([R4-S1]).
sources: WikiTree Grub-4 (Johann Andreas Grub; research notes, will, deeds, child table): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Grub-4
